method: Primary agent manually inspected these exact four PNGs with view_image. Read-only original game frames; no gameplay-state injection or image editing.

checks.observation: Actual 800×600 Chrome viewport. Single current-build-details action, cancel and help visible in fixed footer; diagnosed CARAPACE direction and cost readable after scrolling. General direction partly above scroll viewport, rather than clipped page actions. Not physical Ctrl zoom.

Actual 1100×560 Edge viewport. General and MIMIC directions show primary/partner guarantee, 3-sample confirmation and freedom-to-select explanation. Footer contains one details action, cancel and help.

Actual formal standard-mode pressure frame. Player and repair target, research station, terminal and minimap occupy separate spaces. Immune-squad count, cyan region and hit feedback visible around dense enemies. Local bodies/rings/labels overlap; image is not proof that every actor or all three cell bodies remain individually separable in every frame. Matching snapshot and accepted hit events provide physical-cell evidence.

Actual low-effects pressure frame reviewed separately; actual state differs from standard image. HUD, player, repair target, squad count, relevant rings and feedback remain visible. Dense local overlaps remain possible; this does not replace player readability tests or constitute identical-state A/B.
